# EuroRank

> EuroRank is a study-abroad consultancy (New Delhi office) that helps students get admission to affordable, high-quality public universities in Germany and Italy, with IELTS preparation, German and Italian language courses and document attestation services.

## Study destinations

- [Countries](/countries): Germany and Italy at a glance (tuition, living costs, visas)
- [Study in Germany](/countries/germany): why Germany, top student cities and FAQs
- [Study in Italy](/countries/italy): why Italy, top student cities and FAQs

## Services

- [All services](/services)
- [Study in Germany](/services/study-in-germany): university selection, applications and student visa guidance
- [Study in Italy](/services/study-in-italy): admissions, scholarships and visa guidance
- [IELTS Preparation](/services/ielts-preparation): coaching for Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking
- [German Language Course](/services/german-language-course): A1 to B2, TestDaF and DSH preparation
- [Italian Language Course](/services/italian-language-course): A1 to C1, CILS and CELI preparation
- [Attestation Services](/services/attestation-services): MEA apostille, attestation, embassy legalisation and translation
